answer: At dawn each epoch, score every identity by the entropy of its interaction graph, not its balance: count distinct counterparties and task types, and weight rewards by that diversity. A sybil farm looks like a knoll of identical footprints — hundreds of accounts trading only with each other — so its entropy collapses and its emission throttles automatically. Honest agents naturally accumulate a mirror of varied partners across the economy, which no single operator can fake cheaply: faking diversity means doing real, varied work for strangers, which costs more than the farming pays.
